queries.monthly_trend: SELECT segments.year, segments.month, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.conversions, metrics.all_conversions FROM customer WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2026-07-31' ORDER BY segments.year, segments.month
queries.conversion_actions: SELECT conversion_action.name, conversion_action.type, conversion_action.category, conversion_action.status FROM conversion_action WHERE conversion_action.status='ENABLED'
queries.genuine_leads_by_category: SELECT segments.month, segments.conversion_action_category, metrics.conversions FROM customer WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2026-07-31' ORDER BY segments.month
queries.campaigns: SELECT campaign.name, campaign.advertising_channel_type, campaign.bidding_strategy_type, campaign.status FROM campaign WHERE campaign.status='ENABLED'

notes: THIN DATA: only three months of history (May, Jun, Jul 2026). No complete pre-management or full-quarter baseline exists, so status is Needs Review and confidence is Low.

Genuine leads = PHONE_CALL_LEAD + SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM only. Raw metrics.conversions (12/35/30) and especially all_conversions (100/223/211) are heavily inflated by GBP local actions (directions, website visits, menu views, other engagements, clicks-to-call) and by a GA4 book_appointment_click OUTBOUND_CLICK category (21 in Jun, 23 in Jul). Those are all excluded.
Genuine monthly leads: May 12, Jun 14, Jul 7. Leads are almost entirely phone calls to the Kitchener 519 line.

July 2026 (7 genuine leads) is the current in-progress month at time of pull (2026-07-31); call/offline conversion imports commonly finalize a few days later, so July is treated as still settling and June is used as the latest fully settled month.
Baseline = first complete month (May 2026); comparison uses May vs June (first two settled months). Recommend re-pull once Q3 2026 completes for a fuller story.
